paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, mix (1) scoop (15 g) with 8-12 fl oz of your favorite beverage once (Ix) daily. For best results, add collagen while stirring the beverage to prevent clumping. For an 11 g serving size, fill to the line on the scoop provided.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Notice: Use this product as a food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction.
Collagen is not a complete protein. Do not use to replace dietary protein.
Read entire label prior to use. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.

Consult a healthcare practitioner if you are pregnant or nursing, have a serious medical condition, or use any medications. This product is sold by weight not volume, some settling of contents may occur during shipping.
Packet enclosed to keep product fresh. Do not eat packet.
